what: The paired bootstrap that decides whether attention helped, one resampled mean per draw.
sources: analysis/heldout_test_eval/attn_tuned__best.csv and baseline__best.csv (255,000 per-game errors each, gitignored)
CCS Thesis - Integrated/chapters/chapter4.tex (controlled ablation of the attention mechanism)
method: Per game, the mean of the White and Black absolute errors. The paired delta is the full model minus the reproduced baseline. Each draw resamples all 255,000 games with replacement and takes the mean delta.

recomputed.note: Recomputed here with the same games, the same 10,000 draws and the same seed, and it reproduces the recorded interval to four decimal places. The draws plotted are this recomputation.

published_reference_note: Omori and Tadepalli report 182 on their own data, which is a different corpus and not a like-for-like comparison.
